_about: Original lines for Around Warsaw: affectionate Warsaw humour about the city and its stereotypes, never about real private people, no brand names. Each line is [Polish, English], optionally with a third element of notes for the game: {"only": tag or [tags]} limits it to one situation (kebab orders: "powisle", "praga" across the river, "office"; rescues: "roof", "street", "river", "child", "square"; słoiki: "all" jars intact, "some"; water_tow, loop 10a: "river", "pond"), {"customer": name} names who ordered. {"poster": [lines]} (column_posters, loop 1) is how the poster on an advertising column breaks the line: at most four lines of eight letters. Loop 3g-1 (police, docs/design/police.md section 6): police_warn "speed", "red", "bump"; police_chase "start", "backup", "roadblock" (untagged: every 10 to 12 s); police_lost "escaped", "shift", "heli"; police_stop "routine", "roosters", "trap", "kebab", "sloik" (untagged: the generic opener); police_reply "trap", "kebab" (untagged: always offered; at most 28 characters, they are buttons); police_caution "police", "fifth"; radio_host "traps" ({pl} / {en}: the day's three speed traps). Speech bubbles stay under 70 characters in Polish. Loop MW-0 (Moja Warszawa, docs/design/vision.md section 7): radio_polnoc (PÓŁNOC FM's host Kuba, "south_gate": entering the box from Plac Na Rozdrożu); radio_host (the Hyrax line); club_door (the bouncer: "reject", "queue", "car", "car_black", "dawn"); clubbers; dawn_crowd ("palm"); police_club (the units parked by the clubs, "sober"); schodki ("sunset", "guitar", "fourth"); viral (Wiralek: "queue", "new", "gone", "glon", "late"); runners ("zajac", "hyrax"); dog_walkers ("horn", "influencer"); cyclists ("lane"); metro_announce; bus_stop ("night"); podwozka_request and podwozka_passenger "club" (dawn rides from the club doors); notes (the notebook toasts: "found", "chapter", "kadr"); four signs and four column_posters. The notebook's place cards are in places.json and the tape's then cards in then_cards.json. Crash scenes (crash_scenes.gd, 2026-11-01): crash_scene "driver", "officer", "medic", "gawker" (bubbles at a fender bender); radio_host "crash" ({street}: the road's name, starting the line). Office crowds at Rondo Daszyńskiego (crowds.gd "office" sites and walkers, 2026-11-02): office ("morning" 07-10, "lunch" 11-14, "evening" 16-19, "rain"; untagged anywhere): overheard corporate jokes, no brand names. Beta radio (2026-11-02): the host's greeting when the game starts (dialogue.gd greeting) = radio_hello_morning / _day / _evening / _night + radio_weather_warm / _mild / _cold / _rain ({t}: the temperature, "20 stopni" / "20 degrees") + radio_bye ("morning", "day", "evening", "night"). City-life satire #1, loud cars (loud_cars.gd, 2026-11-02): car_meet (the crowd at the Browary meet; "rev" when a parked car revs), loud_driver (a passing loud supercar's driver), radio_host "loud" (KEBAB FM: "Sąsiedzi znów liczą obroty"). Crazy drivers (crazy_drivers.gd, docs/design/crazy-drivers.md, 2026-11-05): crazy_taxi (the Szkoda Oktawia taxis), crazy_courier (the Szprynter couriers), crazy_pasatini (Janusz in the Pasatini 1.9 TDJ), said when one cuts in or blocks near the player; radio_host "pasatini" (KEBAB FM: a Pasatini sighting).

Plac Centralny: stoisz na kamienicy, której już nie ma.

3 a.m., WACZEK on Marszałkowska: all of Warsaw in one queue.
Gra planszowa w PRZEGRYWKACH: trzy godziny, jedna kłótnia, zero zwycięzców.
A board game at PRZEGRYWKI: three hours, one row, no winners.
Kolejka pod KUKŁĄ sięga Królewskiej. Naleśniki podobno też są.

Latte w KOSZTA COFFEE podrożało. Nazwa w końcu się zgadza.

Atlantic na Chmielnej: seans o 20:00, a o 19:30 już cała ulica w czerni i z okularami.
Atlantic on Chmielna: the show is at 8 p.m., but by 7:30 the whole street is in black, wearing glasses.
Kino Luna na Marszałkowskiej świeci neonem do ostatniego seansu. Potem świeci dla zasady.
Kino Luna on Marszałkowska glows in neon till the last show. After that, on principle.
Kino Kultura na Krakowskim: popcorn za dwanaście, bilet za tyle, co kawa. Kultura kosztuje.
Kino Kultura on Krakowskie: popcorn twelve złoty, a ticket the price of a coffee. Culture costs.

Kino Elektronik on Czerwonego Krzyża: a screening for three people and one cat. The cat is the harshest critic.

Sąsiedzi znów liczą obroty. Okolice Browarów: ktoś sprawdza, czy szyby w oknach są hartowane.

Pasatini widziane na lewym pasie. Prosimy zjechać i się pomodlić.
